newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico frosts hurt about 177,500 acres of crops.
newsitem.headline: Mexico frosts hurt about 177,500 acres of crops.

text.p: Frosts earlier this week damaged about 71,000 hectares (177,500 acres) of crops in this central Mexico state, at a cost of about 50 million pesos, the agriculture ministry said Thursday.
"The affected 71,000 hectares correspond to corn, bean, oat and wheat crops," ministry spokesman Hector Rodriguez told reporters.
Rodriguez said the recent frosts affected at least 14,289 producers in the central region of the state.
"Certainly it will have a negative impact on estimations for the spring-summer cycle...which had a goal of producing more than 300,000 hectares (750,000 acres) of basic grains," he said.
State governor Horacio Sanchez Unzueta said the frosts came after most crops had been harvested, and predicted minimal damage.
